Title: Launch - Force-quit and reopen reaches the main menu
Step: If FreeCell is open, swipe it away from the app switcher, then tap the FreeCell icon.
Expected Result: The app opens.

Title: Launch - Force-quit and reopen reaches the main menu
Step: If Terms & Conditions or the tracking prompt appear, dismiss them (Continue, then Allow).
Expected Result: No pop-up is left on screen.

Title: Launch - Force-quit and reopen reaches the main menu
Step: Wait until the menu finishes appearing.
Expected Result: Play and the rest of the main menu are showing.

Title: Launch - Fresh install shows Terms & Conditions
Step: Delete FreeCell, install the dev build, and open it.
Expected Result: A card reads "To use FreeCell you must agree to our Terms & Conditions and affirm you have reviewed our Privacy Policy" with a Continue button.

Title: Launch - Fresh install shows Terms & Conditions
Step: Tap Continue.
Expected Result: The card goes away. The iOS tracking prompt may appear next.

Title: Launch - Fresh install shows the tracking prompt
Step: After Terms & Conditions, wait for the iOS tracking prompt (Allow / Ask App Not to Track).
Expected Result: The system tracking alert is on screen.

Title: Launch - Fresh install shows the tracking prompt
Step: Tap Allow. Do not tap Ask App Not to Track — that does not clear the gate.
Expected Result: The prompt goes away and the main menu is reachable.

Title: Launch - Terms & Conditions link opens the terms page
Step: On a fresh install, with the Terms & Conditions card on screen and Wi-Fi on, tap the Terms & Conditions link. Do not tap Continue yet.
Expected Result: A PeopleFun Terms of Service page opens, not the Privacy Notice.

Title: Launch - Terms & Conditions link opens the terms page
Step: If Accept All Cookies appears, tap it and wait for the banner to go.
Expected Result: The Terms of Service heading is fully visible.

Title: Launch - Terms & Conditions link opens the terms page
Step: Close the page.
Expected Result: The Terms & Conditions card is still there.

Title: Launch - Privacy Policy link opens the privacy page
Step: On the same card, tap Privacy Policy.
Expected Result: A PeopleFun Privacy Notice page opens, not the Terms of Service.

Title: Launch - Privacy Policy link opens the privacy page
Step: Accept cookies if asked, then close the page.
Expected Result: The Terms & Conditions card is still there. Continue is checked in FL-02.

Title: Main Menu - All eight controls are visible
Step: Open the app and wait until the menu finishes animating.
Expected Result: Play, Daily, Stats, Options, Help, About, More Games, Choose Look, and the FreeCell crown are all on screen.

Title: Main Menu - Welcome tip after the first game opens Options
Step: On a fresh install, deal a game, then tap the table's Back.
Expected Result: A Welcome alert says most features can be enabled and disabled in the Options page, with OK and Options.

Title: Main Menu - Welcome tip after the first game opens Options
Step: Tap Options.
Expected Result: Options opens.

Title: Main Menu - Welcome tip after the first game opens Options
Step: Tap Back.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing and the Welcome alert does not come back.

Title: Statistics - Opens on the Solo tab
Step: From the main menu, tap Stats.
Expected Result: Statistics opens with the Solo tab selected and Game Center in the header.

Title: Statistics - Fresh install reads 0 and none
Step: On a fresh install, before any game, open Stats.
Expected Result: Solo reads best score 0, games played 0, games won 0, playtime 0:00, and Standard • Easy reads best score none.

Title: Statistics - Solo scrolls down to Reset Solo Statistics
Step: On the Solo tab, scroll all the way down. Do not tap Reset.
Expected Result: Standard and Relaxed blocks for every level pass by, and Reset Solo Statistics is at the bottom.

Title: Statistics - Back returns to the main menu
Step: From Statistics, tap Back.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Statistics - Daily tab shows the Daily totals
Step: On Statistics, tap Daily.
Expected Result: The Daily tab is selected. It shows best score, games played, games won, and playtime (0 / 0:00 on a fresh install).

Title: Statistics - Daily scrolls down to Reset Daily Statistics
Step: On the Daily tab, scroll all the way down. Do not tap Reset.
Expected Result: Reset Daily Statistics is at the bottom.

Title: Statistics - Solo shows the score of a won game
Step: Win an Easy game (dev build: QA code, then Synthetic Win) and note the Victory score.
Expected Result: Victory shows a current score.

Title: Statistics - Solo shows the score of a won game
Step: Go to the menu and open Stats on the Solo tab.
Expected Result: Best score and Standard • Easy show that same score, and games won is 1 or more.

Title: Options - Opens from the main menu
Step: From the main menu, tap Options.
Expected Result: Options opens on the Sounds section. The main menu is gone.

Title: Options - Back returns to the main menu
Step: From Options, tap Back.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Options - Applause Volume moves to min, max, and middle
Step: On Options, drag the Applause Volume knob all the way left, all the way right, then to the middle.
Expected Result: The knob sits at the left end, the right end, then in the middle — not only at the two ends.

Title: Options - Applause Volume stays after you leave the screen
Step: Drag Applause Volume to a new position and remember it.
Expected Result: The knob moves.

Title: Options - Applause Volume stays after you leave the screen
Step: Go back to the main menu, then open Options again.
Expected Result: The knob is still where you left it.

Title: Options - Effects Volume moves to min, max, and middle
Step: Drag the Effects Volume knob all the way left, all the way right, then to the middle.
Expected Result: The knob reaches both ends and can sit in the middle.

Title: Options - Auto Mute Sounds turns off and on
Step: Look at Auto Mute Sounds (it ships ON), tap it, then tap it again.
Expected Result: It turns off the first time and back on the second. A tap that does nothing fails.

Title: Options - Maintain Card Spacing turns off and on
Step: In the Cards section, tap Maintain Card Spacing (ships ON) twice.
Expected Result: It turns off, then back on.

Title: Options - Card Bouncing turns off and on
Step: Tap Card Bouncing (ships ON) twice.
Expected Result: It turns off, then back on.

Title: Options - Card Lowering moves to min, max, and middle
Step: In Interface, drag the Card Lowering knob all the way left, all the way right, then to the middle.
Expected Result: The knob reaches both ends and can sit in the middle.

Title: Options - Show Status Bar OFF hides the status bar in a game
Step: On a game table, note the iOS status bar (time, battery). Open the in-game menu → options and turn Show Status Bar off. Go back to the table.
Expected Result: The status bar is gone and the table moves up.

Title: Options - Show Status Bar OFF hides the status bar in a game
Step: Turn Show Status Bar back on and return to the table.
Expected Result: The status bar is back and the table is where it started.

Title: Options - Show Card Messages ON explains a stuck card
Step: On a table, fill all four free cells, then tap a bottom card that has nowhere to go.
Expected Result: "this card cannot attach anywhere" flashes on the felt for under a second.

Title: Options - Show Card Messages OFF hides the stuck-card note
Step: Turn Show Card Messages off, go back to the same table, and tap the same stuck card.
Expected Result: No "cannot attach" note appears. Turn the switch back on afterwards.

Title: Options - UI Brightness moves to min, max, and middle
Step: Drag the UI Brightness knob all the way left, all the way right, then to the middle.
Expected Result: The knob reaches both ends and can sit in the middle.

Title: Options - Auto Hint turns on and off
Step: Tap Auto Hint (ships OFF), then tap it again.
Expected Result: It turns on, then back off.

Title: Options - Contact Us opens support
Step: With Wi-Fi on, open Options and tap Contact Us.
Expected Result: You leave Options and the PeopleFun Support page opens.

Title: Options - Contact Us still leaves Options without internet
Step: With Airplane Mode on and Wi-Fi off, open Options and tap Contact Us.
Expected Result: You leave Options. A no-connection page instead of PeopleFun Support is expected — the redirect still happened.

Title: Options - Contact Us still leaves Options without internet
Step: Close the support page.
Expected Result: Options is showing again.

Title: Help - Opens on Introduction
Step: From the main menu, tap Help.
Expected Result: Help opens with the foundations / cells / tableaux diagram and the Introduction heading.

Title: Help - Rules scroll down to the FAQ link
Step: Scroll Help all the way down.
Expected Result: Rules, Undo button and Menu button pass by, and a frequently asked questions link is at the bottom.

Title: Help - Back returns to the main menu
Step: From Help, tap Back.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Help - FAQ link opens the FAQ
Step: At the bottom of Help, tap frequently asked questions.
Expected Result: The FAQ opens inside FreeCell.

Title: Help - FAQ link opens the FAQ
Step: Tap Back.
Expected Result: Help is showing again.

Title: About - Opens from the About menu item
Step: From the main menu, tap ABOUT.
Expected Result: About opens with "FreeCell ▻ Solitaire" and the copyright line.

Title: About - Version and links are on the page
Step: Look over About. Do not tap ad free version or submit feedback here.
Expected Result: A Version line, © PeopleFun, Inc., and the links help, ad free version, frequently asked questions, more games, and submit feedback.

Title: About - Tapping the version line shows the build
Step: Tap the Version line.
Expected Result: It changes to the build number and hash, e.g. "279 build 60706F".

Title: About - Frequently asked questions stays in the app
Step: Tap frequently asked questions.
Expected Result: The FAQ opens inside FreeCell with General, Solo, and Daily tabs. You do not leave for a browser.

Title: About - FAQ scrolls down to submit feedback
Step: On the FAQ's General tab, scroll all the way down.
Expected Result: submit feedback is at the bottom. The FAQ header stays put.

Title: About - Crown logo also opens About
Step: From the main menu, tap the FreeCell crown.
Expected Result: About opens, the same screen as the ABOUT item.

Title: About - Help link opens Help and comes back
Step: On About, tap help.
Expected Result: Help opens on Introduction.

Title: About - Help link opens Help and comes back
Step: Tap Back.
Expected Result: About is showing again, not the main menu.

Title: About - More games link opens More Games and comes back
Step: On About, tap more games.
Expected Result: The in-app More Games stage opens. The App Store does not.

Title: About - More games link opens More Games and comes back
Step: Tap Back.
Expected Result: About is showing again.

Title: About - Back returns to the main menu
Step: From About, tap Back.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: FAQ - Opens on the General tab
Step: Open the FAQ from About.
Expected Result: General is selected and the first question is "How do I play a Solo or Daily game?".

Title: FAQ - Solo tab answers What are Solo games
Step: Tap Solo.
Expected Result: Solo is selected and the first question is "What are Solo games?".

Title: FAQ - Daily tab answers What are Daily games
Step: Tap Daily.
Expected Result: Daily is selected and the first question is "What are Daily games?".

Title: FAQ - Back returns to About
Step: From the FAQ opened on About, tap Back.
Expected Result: About is showing.

Title: Ad-free - Link asks No or Yes before the store
Section Hierarchy: FreeCell Solitaire Obj-C > App Store / Mail
Step: On About, tap ad free version.
Expected Result: A card asks "Would you like to take a look at the Ad free version?" with No and Yes. You are still in FreeCell.

Title: Ad-free - No leaves you on About
Section Hierarchy: FreeCell Solitaire Obj-C > App Store / Mail
Step: On that card, tap No.
Expected Result: The card closes. About is showing and the App Store did not open.

Title: Ad-free - Yes opens the ad-free FreeCell in the App Store
Section Hierarchy: FreeCell Solitaire Obj-C > App Store / Mail
Step: With Wi-Fi on, tap ad free version, then Yes.
Expected Result: The App Store opens on the paid, ad-free FreeCell.

Title: Ad-free - Status-bar back lands on About
Section Hierarchy: FreeCell Solitaire Obj-C > App Store / Mail
Step: From the App Store, tap ◀ FreeCell in the status bar.
Expected Result: About is showing. Landing on the main menu means the app restarted instead of resuming.

Title: Feedback - Submit feedback asks Cancel or Write Email
Section Hierarchy: FreeCell Solitaire Obj-C > App Store / Mail
Step: On About, tap submit feedback.
Expected Result: "We appreciate your feedback" offers Cancel and Write Email.

Title: Feedback - Cancel leaves you on About
Section Hierarchy: FreeCell Solitaire Obj-C > App Store / Mail
Step: On that alert, tap Cancel.
Expected Result: The alert closes and About is showing.

Title: Feedback - Write Email opens a Mail draft
Section Hierarchy: FreeCell Solitaire Obj-C > App Store / Mail
Step: Tap submit feedback, then Write Email. A Mail account must be set up on the phone.
Expected Result: Mail opens with a draft. No Mail Accounts is the phone setup, not the game.

Title: Feedback - Subject names the game, version, phone, and iOS
Section Hierarchy: FreeCell Solitaire Obj-C > App Store / Mail
Step: Read the draft subject. Compare it with Settings → General → About and the game's About.
Expected Result: The subject names FreeCell, the app version, this phone's model, and this iOS version.

Title: Feedback - Delete the draft — do not send
Section Hierarchy: FreeCell Solitaire Obj-C > App Store / Mail
Step: Delete the draft. Never tap send.
Expected Result: The draft is gone. Nothing was sent.

Title: Feedback - Status-bar back returns to FreeCell
Section Hierarchy: FreeCell Solitaire Obj-C > App Store / Mail
Step: From Mail, tap ◀ FreeCell in the status bar.
Expected Result: FreeCell is in front. Mail is a separate app, so the main menu is acceptable.

Title: More Games - Gift icon opens the in-app promo page
Step: From the main menu, tap More Games (the gift icon).
Expected Result: A curtained stage opens with "Tap any game to download it!". The App Store does not open.

Title: More Games - Swipe reveals Card Games and Spiderette
Step: Swipe the stage up until it stops.
Expected Result: Card Games and Spiderette come into view. Back and the instruction line stay put.

Title: More Games - Back returns to the main menu
Step: From More Games, tap Back.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Promo icons - Five game icons on the menu after a game
Step: After at least one game, go to the main menu and wait a few seconds.
Expected Result: Five icons sit on the left beside "more fun with us!": Spider, Solitaire, Sudoku 2, Card Games, and Spiderette.

Title: Promo icons - Spider opens Spider Solitaire
Step: With Wi-Fi on, tap the Spider icon.
Expected Result: The App Store opens on Spider Solitaire.

Title: Promo icons - Spider opens Spider Solitaire
Step: Tap ◀ FreeCell in the status bar.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing. FreeCell did not restart.

Title: Promo icons - Solitaire opens Solitaire
Step: Tap the Solitaire icon.
Expected Result: The App Store opens on Solitaire.

Title: Promo icons - Solitaire opens Solitaire
Step: Switch back to FreeCell.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Promo icons - Sudoku 2 opens Sudoku
Step: Tap the Sudoku 2 icon.
Expected Result: The App Store opens on Sudoku.

Title: Promo icons - Sudoku 2 opens Sudoku
Step: Switch back to FreeCell.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Promo icons - Card Games opens Card Games
Step: Tap the Card Games icon.
Expected Result: The App Store opens on Card Games.

Title: Promo icons - Card Games opens Card Games
Step: Switch back to FreeCell.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Promo icons - Spiderette opens Spiderette
Step: Tap the Spiderette icon.
Expected Result: The App Store opens on Spiderette.

Title: Promo icons - Spiderette opens Spiderette
Step: Switch back to FreeCell.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Play - Opens the difficulty picker
Step: From the main menu, tap Play.
Expected Result: The difficulty picker opens. No game starts yet.

Title: Play - Picker shows all five levels
Step: Open Play.
Expected Result: Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert, and Master are listed, with LAST SCORE at the bottom.

Title: Play - Easy starts a game
Step: On the picker, tap Easy. If asked to abandon a paused game, tap Yes.
Expected Result: The game table is showing: foundations, free cells, and eight columns.

Title: Play - Declining abandon stays on the picker
Step: With a paused game, open Play and tap a level.
Expected Result: "Are you sure you want to abandon the currently paused game?" appears.

Title: Play - Declining abandon stays on the picker
Step: Tap No.
Expected Result: The picker stays open and the Resume ribbon is still there.

Title: Play - Rules toggle switches standard and relaxed
Step: On the picker, tap "standard rules / tap to change".
Expected Result: It reads relaxed rules and explains that relaxed rules let piles of any size move but score less.

Title: Play - Rules toggle switches standard and relaxed
Step: Tap it again.
Expected Result: It reads standard rules again.

Title: Play - Resume continues the paused game
Step: Make a move on a table, tap Back, then tap Play.
Expected Result: The red ribbon under the levels reads Resume.

Title: Play - Resume continues the paused game
Step: Tap Resume.
Expected Result: The same board comes back, with your move still made.

Title: Play - Relaxed rules deal a relaxed game
Step: Switch the picker to relaxed rules and tap Easy.
Expected Result: The table footer reads "easy level relaxed rules".

Title: Play - Relaxed rules deal a relaxed game
Step: Go back and switch the picker to standard rules.
Expected Result: The picker reads standard rules again.

Title: Gameplay - Table controls are on screen
Step: Start an Easy game.
Expected Result: Back, new, the move counter, and menu at the top; four foundations, four free cells, and eight columns; tap to undo, tap to lower, and tap for hints at the bottom.

Title: Gameplay - Tapping a card moves it
Step: Tap the bottom card of a column that has a legal move.
Expected Result: The card moves to a column, a free cell, or a foundation, and the move counter goes up by one.

Title: Gameplay - Undo puts the board back
Step: After a move, tap tap to undo.
Expected Result: The card is back where it was and the move counter goes back down.

Title: Gameplay - Tap to lower drops the playfield
Step: Tap tap to lower once.
Expected Result: The whole playfield slides down.

Title: Gameplay - Tap to raise brings the playfield back
Step: With the playfield lowered, tap the same control again.
Expected Result: The playfield slides back up to where it started.

Title: Gameplay - Tap for hints steps through moves
Step: Tap tap for hints.
Expected Result: The label changes to "tap for more / move 1 of N".

Title: Gameplay - Tap for hints steps through moves
Step: Tap it again.
Expected Result: It reads move 2 of N.

Title: Gameplay - In-game menu shows all its actions
Step: On the table, tap menu.
Expected Result: A drawer shows replay, abandon, options, new, help, FAQ, and the rotation lock.

Title: Gameplay - Rank Strip OFF hides the A-K strip
Step: On a table, note the A 2 3 … K strip above the bottom labels. Turn Rank Strip off in Options and go back.
Expected Result: The strip is gone.

Title: Gameplay - Rank Strip ON brings the strip back
Step: Turn Rank Strip back on and go back to the table.
Expected Result: The A-K strip is back.

Title: Gameplay - Rich Features OFF hides timer, score, multiplier
Step: Turn Rich Features off in Options and go back to the table.
Expected Result: Timer, score, multiplier, and the move counter are gone.

Title: Gameplay - Rich Features ON brings timer, score, multiplier back
Step: Turn Rich Features back on and go back to the table.
Expected Result: Timer, score, multiplier, and moves are visible again.

Title: Gameplay - Timer waits for the first move
Step: Deal a new game and wait about ten seconds without touching a card.
Expected Result: The timer still reads 0:00 and the footer says tap a card to start.

Title: Gameplay - Timer waits for the first move
Step: Move a card.
Expected Result: The timer starts counting.

Title: Gameplay - Rules prompt after the first deal opens Help
Step: On a fresh install, deal the first game and wait a few seconds.
Expected Result: "Would you like to review the game rules before to play?" appears with No and Yes.

Title: Gameplay - Rules prompt after the first deal opens Help
Step: Tap Yes, then Back on Help.
Expected Result: Help opened, and Back returns to the same table.

Title: Gameplay - New deals a different board
Step: Look at the board, tap new, and confirm if asked.
Expected Result: A different deal is on the table.

Title: Gameplay - Replay asks first, and No keeps the board
Step: Make a move, open the menu, and tap replay.
Expected Result: "Are you sure you want to play this game again?" warns that the replay breaks the current run and is not recorded.

Title: Gameplay - Replay asks first, and No keeps the board
Step: Tap No.
Expected Result: The board still has your move.

Title: Gameplay - Replay Yes restores the original deal
Step: Tap replay again and answer Yes.
Expected Result: The page turns and the original deal is back: the move is undone, the counter is 0, and the timer reads 0:00.

Title: Gameplay - Menu help opens Help and returns to the table
Step: Open the menu and tap help.
Expected Result: Help opens on Introduction.

Title: Gameplay - Menu help opens Help and returns to the table
Step: Tap Back.
Expected Result: The same table is showing.

Title: Gameplay - Menu FAQ opens on Solo and returns to the table
Step: Open the menu and tap FAQ.
Expected Result: The FAQ opens with the Solo tab selected.

Title: Gameplay - Menu FAQ opens on Solo and returns to the table
Step: Tap Back.
Expected Result: The same table is showing.

Title: Gameplay - Menu options opens Options and returns to the table
Step: Open the menu and tap options.
Expected Result: Options opens.

Title: Gameplay - Menu options opens Options and returns to the table
Step: Tap Back.
Expected Result: The same table is showing.

Title: Gameplay - A stuck card offers help
Step: With all free cells full, tap a card that has nowhere to go.
Expected Result: A help button replaces the score and timer under the board.

Title: Gameplay - A stuck card offers help
Step: Tap help.
Expected Result: Help opens. Back returns to the table.

Title: Gameplay - Rotation lock keeps the table in portrait
Step: Open the menu and tap the round arrow (rotation lock).
Expected Result: The first time, an alert says the interface orientation is locked. Tap OK.

Title: Gameplay - Rotation lock keeps the table in portrait
Step: Turn the phone to landscape.
Expected Result: The table stays in portrait.

Title: Gameplay - Unlocked table turns to landscape
Step: Tap the rotation lock again, then turn the phone to landscape.
Expected Result: The table turns: foundations in a left column, free cells in a right column.

Title: Gameplay - Unlocked table turns to landscape
Step: Turn the phone back to portrait.
Expected Result: The portrait table is back.

Title: Gameplay - Abandon ends the game
Step: Open the menu and tap abandon. Confirm if asked.
Expected Result: The game ends and you leave the table. Play shows no Resume ribbon for it.

Title: Gameplay - Tapping a buried card highlights its rank
Step: Tap a card that is buried under others.
Expected Result: Every card of that rank is outlined. Nothing moves.

Title: Relaunch - Same board after closing the app for a few seconds
Step: On a table, make one move and remember the board.
Expected Result: The board has changed from the deal.

Step: Press Home first (the app saves when it goes to the background), swipe FreeCell away, wait about 3 seconds, and open it again.
Expected Result: The same table comes back. A tap a card to start overlay is fine.

Title: Relaunch - Same board after closing the app for 35 seconds
Step: Do the same, but wait about 35 seconds before opening it.
Expected Result: The same table comes back.

Step: Tap the Victory screen's Back — not new.

Step: From Last Score, tap Back.

Step: Tap the level button.

Title: Daily - Today deals a Daily game
Step: With Wi-Fi on, tap today.
Expected Result: A Daily table is dealt, with a star in its header and the chosen level in its footer.

Title: Daily - Winning today puts a gold star on the calendar
Step: Win today's Daily game (Synthetic Win) and go back to Daily.
Expected Result: Today carries a gold star.

Title: Daily - A Daily win counts on the Daily statistics
Step: Open Stats → Daily after that win.
Expected Result: Games won is 1 and best score shows the win.

Title: Choose Look - Opens on the Surface tab
Step: From the main menu, tap Choose Look.
Expected Result: The look picker opens on Surface, with six felts and Simulate Depth.

Title: Choose Look - Close returns to the main menu
Step: Tap the X.
Expected Result: The picker closes and the main menu is usable.

Title: Choose Look - Surface and Cards tabs switch
Step: Tap Cards, then Surface.
Expected Result: Cards shows six card backs and Extra Large Card-Symbols. Surface shows the felts again.

Title: Choose Look - Another surface shows on the game table
Step: Pick a different felt, close the picker, and start or resume Easy.
Expected Result: The table felt matches the felt you picked.

Title: Choose Look - Another card back shows on the table
Step: Pick a different card back and look at the table's undo and hint piles.
Expected Result: The backs match the deck you picked.

Title: Choose Look - Extra Large Card-Symbols turns on and off
Step: On Cards, tap Extra Large Card-Symbols (ships OFF) twice.
Expected Result: It turns on, then back off.

Title: Choose Look - Simulate Depth turns off and on
Step: On Surface, tap Simulate Depth twice.
Expected Result: It changes state, then returns to where it was.

Title: Reset Statistics - Solo reset asks twice
Step: On Solo, scroll to Reset Solo Statistics and tap it.
Expected Result: "Would you like to reset local scores?" notes that Game Center scores are not reset (No / Yes).

Title: Reset Statistics - Solo reset asks twice
Step: Tap Yes.
Expected Result: "Just to be on the safe side…" asks once more (No / Yes).

Title: Reset Statistics - Confirming wipes the Solo scores
Step: Tap Yes on the second alert, then open Stats.
Expected Result: You land on the main menu. Solo reads best score 0 and every level none.

Title: Reset Statistics - Declining leaves the Solo scores alone
Step: Tap Reset Solo Statistics, then No.
Expected Result: Statistics stays open and the scores are unchanged.

Title: Reset Statistics - Daily reset asks twice
Step: On Daily, scroll to Reset Daily Statistics and tap it, then Yes.
Expected Result: The same two alerts as the Solo reset appear.

Title: Reset Statistics - Confirming wipes the Daily scores
Step: Tap Yes on the second alert, then open Stats → Daily.
Expected Result: You land on the main menu. Daily reads 0 everywhere.

Title: Reset Statistics - Declining leaves the Daily scores alone
Step: Tap Reset Daily Statistics, then No.
Expected Result: Statistics stays open on Daily and nothing changed.
